aka.zh: 9号干线及16号干线（2004 年以前）

tagline.en: From the airport to Sha Tin over two of the world's longest-span bridges and through four tunnels
tagline.zh: 由机场到沙田，跨越两座世界级大跨度桥梁，穿过四条隧道

start.en: Airport Road at Chek Lap Kok, by Hong Kong International Airport
start.zh: 赤鱲角机场路，香港国际机场旁

end.en: Sha Tin, where the Tsing Sha Highway meets Route 9 at Tai Po Road – Sha Tin
end.zh: 沙田，青沙公路于大埔公路－沙田段与9号干线相接

en: Route 8 runs 33.1 km from Chek Lap Kok to Sha Tin, a dual three-lane motorway the whole way, and it is the second-longest trunk route in Hong Kong. From the airport it follows the north shore of Lantau as the North Lantau Highway past Tung Chung and Sunny Bay, crosses to Ma Wan and Tsing Yi as the Lantau Link, and continues as the Tsing Sha Highway through Tsing Yi, over the Rambler Channel to Stonecutters Island, across Cheung Sha Wan and Lai Chi Kok on viaduct, and under the hills to Tai Wai.

It is a road of big structures. When they opened, the Tsing Ma Bridge was the longest road-and-rail suspension span in the world and Stonecutters Bridge the second-longest cable-stayed span, and the route has four tunnels — Nam Wan, Eagle's Nest, Sha Tin Heights and Tai Wai — more than any other trunk route. The North Lantau Highway carries the highest speed limit in Hong Kong, 110 km/h.

It connects with Route 3 twice, at Cheung Sha Wan and on Tsing Yi, with Route 7 near Lai Chi Kok and with Route 9 at Sha Tin, and it was for twenty-three years the only road to the airport and to Lantau. Its chainage, unusually, rises from west to east, and its signs use all four compass points.
zh: 8号干线由赤鱲角至沙田，全长 33.1 公里，全程为三线双程快速公路，是全港第二长的干线。由机场起，它以北大屿山公路之名沿大屿山北岸经东涌、欣澳，以青屿干线跨海至马湾和青衣，再以青沙公路穿过青衣，跨越蓝巴勒海峡到昂船洲，以高架形式越过长沙湾和荔枝角，然后在山底穿往大围。
这是一条由大型结构物组成的路。落成之时，青马大桥是全球跨度最长的公路铁路两用悬索桥，昂船洲大桥的主跨则为全球斜拉桥第二长；干线上有南湾、尖山、沙田岭和大围四条隧道，是隧道最多的干线。北大屿山公路限速每小时 110 公里，是全港最高。
它两度与3号干线相交——在长沙湾和青衣——并在荔枝角附近与7号干线相交，在沙田与9号干线相接；二十三年间，它是通往机场和大屿山的唯一道路。它的里程由西向东递增，这在香港并不常见，路标上东南西北四个方位都会用到。

en: The Tsing Ma Bridge, designed by Mott MacDonald and begun on 25 May 1992, is a suspension bridge with a main span of 1,377 m and a total length of 2,160 m. It has two decks: an open upper deck for the dual three-lane road and an enclosed lower deck carrying the Airport Express and Tung Chung line tracks and two single-lane emergency roadways, used when wind or accidents close the top. It was for nineteen years the longest road-and-rail suspension span in the world. The Lantau Link continues over the Ma Wan Viaduct and the Kap Shui Mun Bridge to Lantau.

Stonecutters Bridge, begun on 27 April 2004 and opened on 20 December 2009, is a cable-stayed bridge 1,596 m long with a main span of 1,018 m, the second-longest cable-stayed span in the world when it was completed. Its two single-pole towers rise about 295 m, concrete to 175 m and stainless-steel-skinned composite above, and the deck gives 73.5 m of clearance over the entrance to the container port. Because of typhoons, wind speed, direction and turbulence were measured from a mast on the site from October 2002 to January 2004.

Between Tsing Yi and Cheung Sha Wan the road runs 7.6 km: the West Tsing Yi Viaduct, the 1.2 km Nam Wan Tunnel, the East Tsing Yi Viaduct, the bridge and the 2.2 km Ngong Shuen Chau Viaduct. East of there the 1.4 km Lai Chi Kok Viaduct was added on top of two existing flyovers above the West Kowloon Highway, making five levels of road with Lin Cheung Road below. Because the roads and railway underneath could not be closed, it was built of precast segments of 70 to 120 tonnes lifted into place at night, about four hours a night, over nine months.

The Cheung Sha Wan–Sha Tin section then goes underground: the 2.1 km Eagle's Nest Tunnel, a toll plaza in the Sha Tin Heights valley, the 1 km Sha Tin Heights Tunnel and the short Tai Wai Tunnel. Its tunnels carry kilometres of linear heat detectors in the roof, and emergency gates between the carriageways on the viaducts let fire engines cross over.
zh: 青马大桥由莫特·麦克唐纳公司设计，1992 年 5 月 25 日动工，是主跨 1,377 米、全长 2,160 米的悬索桥。它采用双层设计：露天上层为三线双程快速公路，有盖下层铺设机场快线及东涌线路轨，另有两条单线紧急行车道，在强风或严重事故封闭上层时使用。此后十九年间，它一直是全球最长的公路铁路两用悬索桥。青屿干线随后经马湾高架路和汲水门大桥抵达大屿山。
昂船洲大桥 2004 年 4 月 27 日动工，2009 年 12 月 20 日通车，是全长 1,596 米、主跨 1,018 米的斜拉桥，落成时主跨为全球第二长。两座独柱桥塔高约 295 米，175 米以下为混凝土，其上为外包不锈钢的组合结构；桥面在货柜港入口上方提供 73.5 米净空。由于香港常受台风吹袭，工地自 2002 年 10 月至 2004 年 1 月以测风杆实测风速、风向及湍流。
青衣至长沙湾段长 7.6 公里，依次为西青衣高架路、长 1.2 公里的南湾隧道、东青衣高架路、昂船洲大桥和长 2.2 公里的昂船洲高架路。再往东，长 1.4 公里的荔枝角高架路叠建在西九龙公路上方原有的两层天桥之上，连同地面的连翔道形成五层车路。由于下方的道路和铁路都不能封闭，工程采用每件重 70 至 120 吨的预制组件，只能在深夜吊装，每晚工作约 4 小时，历时 9 个月。
长沙湾至沙田段随即转入地下：长 2.1 公里的尖山隧道、设于沙田岭山谷的收费广场、长 1 公里的沙田岭隧道，以及较短的大围隧道。隧道顶部装有长达数公里的线型热力感应器；高架路段两个行车方向之间设有紧急闸口，可让消防车驶过。

en: A road from Chek Lap Kok to Tsing Yi was first designed and assessed in 1981–83, when the site had already been chosen for a new airport, and stopped when the airport plan was shelved. It came back with the Airport Core Programme announced in 1989: planning resumed in 1990, the Chek Lap Kok–Tsing Yi road was numbered Route 9 and the Tsing Yi–Sha Tin road Route 16. The Lantau Link was opened on 27 April 1997 by Margaret Thatcher, the governor Chris Patten and the Chief Secretary Anson Chan, and the North Lantau Highway, Kap Shui Mun Bridge and Tsing Ma Bridge opened to traffic on 22 May.

Work on the eastern half began in 2002 — April for the Tsing Yi–Cheung Sha Wan section, November for Cheung Sha Wan–Sha Tin — and in the renumbering of 31 January 2004 the two old numbers were merged as Route 8. The Nam Wan Tunnel was finished on 25 February 2005 but had to wait for the bridge; until then traffic used Route 3 between the two halves.

The Cheung Sha Wan–Sha Tin section, named the Tsing Sha Highway, opened on 21 March 2008, after the Community Chest walked it on 24 February. The Community Chest walked Stonecutters Bridge and the Nam Wan Tunnel on 15 November 2009, and the last section opened on 20 December 2009, completing the route.

The Lai Chi Kok Viaduct finished about 24 months late. In 2018 the Legislative Council's Public Accounts Committee heard that the contractor, blaming the design consultant, had claimed up to HK$1 billion; the Highways Department settled for HK$273 million and recovered HK$133 million from the consultant.
zh: 早在 1981 至 1983 年，政府已选定在赤鱲角兴建新机场，并首次为机场至青衣的公路进行工程设计与评估；但新机场计划一度搁置，这次规划亦告中止。1989 年公布机场核心计划后，1990 年再度展开规划：赤鱲角至青衣段编为9号干线，青衣至沙田段编为16号干线。青屿干线于 1997 年 4 月 27 日由撒切尔夫人、港督彭定康及布政司陈方安生主持开幕，北大屿山公路、汲水门大桥及青马大桥于 5 月 22 日通车。
东半段于 2002 年动工——青衣至长沙湾段 4 月，长沙湾至沙田段 11 月。2004 年 1 月 31 日重新编号，两个旧编号合并为8号干线。南湾隧道于 2005 年 2 月 25 日已经竣工，但须等候昂船洲大桥落成才一并通车；在此之前，两段之间的车辆须取道3号干线。
长沙湾至沙田段命名为青沙公路，公益金于 2 月 24 日先在该段举行百万行，3 月 21 日通车。2009 年 11 月 15 日，公益金在昂船洲大桥及南湾隧道举行百万行；最后一段于 12 月 20 日通车，8号干线全线贯通。
荔枝角高架路较原定完工日期迟约 24 个月。2018 年，立法会政府账目委员会聆讯时得悉，承建商归咎设计顾问，向政府申索最多 10 亿元；路政署最终以 2.73 亿元和解，并向顾问公司追回 1.33 亿元。

en: All of Route 8 was paid for by the government. The western half was one of the ten Airport Core Programme projects, whose one build-operate-transfer franchise, the Western Harbour Crossing, is on Route 3. The two eastern sections, built a decade later, were approved at HK$11.72 billion and HK$6.76 billion, against HK$7.14 billion for the Tsing Ma Bridge.

The Lantau Link was tolled from 1997, for some years in one direction only, collected on the way back from Lantau. The toll was abolished on 27 December 2020, eight hours before the Tuen Mun–Chek Lap Kok Link opened as a second road to the airport. The Eagle's Nest and Sha Tin Heights tunnels remain tolled as one.
zh: 8号干线全线由政府出资。西半段是机场核心计划十项工程之一；该计划中唯一以“建造、营运、移交”专营权模式兴建的西区海底隧道，属于3号干线。十年后兴建的东面两段，核准工程费分别为 117.2 亿和 67.6 亿港元，而青马大桥为 71.4 亿港元。
青屿干线自 1997 年起收费，其中多年只在离开大屿山时单向收取来回费用。2020 年 12 月 27 日，即屯门至赤鱲角连接路作为第二条通往机场的道路通车前八小时，青屿干线取消收费。尖山隧道及沙田岭隧道至今仍合并收费。

en: Drivers on the North Lantau Highway can do 110 km/h; the Lantau Link is limited to 80 km/h, and the Tsing Sha Highway to 70 km/h north of its toll plaza and 80 km/h south of it. In strong winds the Lantau Link's lower-deck roadways open while the upper deck is closed. When the Cheung Sha Wan–Sha Tin section opened, Sha Tin to West Kowloon came down to about ten minutes, and Sha Tin to the airport to about 25.
zh: 北大屿山公路限速每小时 110 公里；青屿干线限速 80 公里；青沙公路收费广场以北限速 70 公里，以南 80 公里。强风时，青屿干线上层封闭，改为开放下层行车道。长沙湾至沙田段通车后，由沙田到西九龙只需约 10 分钟，到机场约 25 分钟。

why.en: No route-wide total is published: the route was built as separate projects in 1992–1997 and 2002–2009. Sourced figures for its main parts are given below; none was found for the North Lantau Highway on its own.
why.zh: 全线没有公布总造价：它是在 1992—1997 年及 2002—2009 年分项兴建的。主要部分有来源的数字列于下方；未找到北大屿山公路单独的造价。

label.zh: 青衣至长沙湾段（含昂船洲大桥）

figures.source: Highways Department, Route 8 between Tsing Yi and Cheung Sha Wan (project page, as at 30 April 2009, Internet Archive)

value.en: HK$2.76 billion, reported as over budget. A press figure; not checked against the Highways Department's contract account.
value.zh: 27.6 亿港元，据报超支。该数字出自新闻报道，未与路政署合约账目核对。

value.zh: 核准工程费 67.597 亿港元。通车时《明报》报道耗资 58 亿港元，两者差异未见解释。

figures.source: Highways Department, Route 8 between Cheung Sha Wan and Sha Tin (project page, as at 31 August 2008, Internet Archive); Ming Pao, 24 February 2008, as cited in Chinese Wikipedia, 8號幹線

value.en: The Hong Kong government throughout: the Lantau Link and North Lantau Highway as Airport Core Programme projects, the Tsing Sha Highway from the public works programme. None of it is a franchise.
value.zh: 全线由香港政府出资：青屿干线和北大屿山公路属机场核心计划工程，青沙公路则由工务计划拨款。没有任何路段采用专营权模式。

figures.source: English Wikipedia, Airport Core Programme; Highways Department project pages for Route 8

timeline.en: Planning resumes under the Airport Core Programme; the road is split into Route 9 (Chek Lap Kok–Tsing Yi) and Route 16 (Tsing Yi–Sha Tin).
timeline.zh: 随机场核心计划重新展开规划，分为9号干线（赤鱲角至青衣）和16号干线（青衣至沙田）。

timeline.en: Work on the Tsing Ma Bridge begins on 25 May.
timeline.zh: 5 月 25 日，青马大桥动工。

timeline.en: The Lantau Link is opened on 27 April and opens to traffic, with the North Lantau Highway, on 22 May.
timeline.zh: 4 月 27 日青屿干线开幕，5 月 22 日连同北大屿山公路通车。

timeline.en: Work starts on the Tsing Yi–Cheung Sha Wan section in April and the Cheung Sha Wan–Sha Tin section in November.
timeline.zh: 4 月青衣至长沙湾段动工，11 月长沙湾至沙田段动工。

timeline.en: Routes 9 and 16 are merged as Route 8 on 31 January; Stonecutters Bridge is begun on 27 April.
timeline.zh: 1 月 31 日，9号及16号干线合并为8号干线；4 月 27 日，昂船洲大桥动工。

timeline.en: The Tsing Sha Highway opens from Cheung Sha Wan to Sha Tin on 21 March.
timeline.zh: 3 月 21 日，青沙公路长沙湾至沙田段通车。

timeline.en: Stonecutters Bridge and the Nam Wan Tunnel open on 20 December, completing the route.
timeline.zh: 12 月 20 日，昂船洲大桥及南湾隧道通车，全线贯通。

timeline.en: The Public Accounts Committee hears the Lai Chi Kok Viaduct claim.
timeline.zh: 立法会政府账目委员会就荔枝角高架路索偿事件举行聆讯。

timeline.en: The Lantau Link toll is abolished on 27 December.
timeline.zh: 12 月 27 日，青屿干线取消收费。
